ThingDef.label: Altmer leather
ThingDef.description: Tanned skin taken from a High Elf. It keeps a faint golden cast long after curing. Any Altmer who saw it would want the tanner hanged, and most other people would not argue.

ThingDef.label: Ayleid leather
ThingDef.description: Pale, fine-grained skin from one of the Heartland High Elves. The Ayleids once flayed their slaves for sport. Seeing it done to them is a grim sort of balance.

ThingDef.label: Bosmer leather
ThingDef.description: Thin brown skin from a Wood Elf. Under the Green Pact the Bosmer wear the hides of what they kill, which makes this one of the few things a Bosmer would find hard to argue against.

ThingDef.label: Dunmer leather
ThingDef.description: Ash-gray skin from a Dark Elf. It cures tough and dark and smells faintly of smoke. A Dunmer family would sooner burn the whole house than let this be worn.

ThingDef.label: Dwemer leather
ThingDef.description: Skin from one of the Deep Elves, ruddy and surprisingly thick. Scholars would pay a fortune to study it. Most of them would also be sick on the spot.

ThingDef.label: Falmer leather
ThingDef.description: Clammy blue-white skin from one of the blind Falmer. It never quite loses the damp of the caves.

ThingDef.label: Snow Elf leather
ThingDef.description: Snow-white skin from one of the last true Snow Elves. There are so few of them left that every scrap of this is a small act of extinction.

ThingDef.label: Maormer leather
ThingDef.description: Translucent, faintly blue skin from a Sea Elf of Pyandonea. It holds up well in salt water, which is about the only good thing anyone has said about it.

ThingDef.label: Orsimer leather
ThingDef.description: Thick green hide from an Orc. Wearing it near a stronghold is a quick way to start a blood feud that outlives everyone involved.

ThingDef.label: Khajiit pelt
ThingDef.description: A tanned Khajiit pelt with the fur left on. It is warm, soft and unmistakable. Every caravan between Elsweyr and Skyrim would know whose it was.
